missions.briefing: The official tutorial campaign of DTA. Learn the basics of classic Command & Conquer.
missions.title: Tutorial Mission 1

missions.briefing:
Nod forces are faster than we thought. The outpost you destroyed was actually a secondary base they were bringing on-line. We've located their main base, and need it removed in order to secure the area.

GDI has already established a foothold in the area, but needs someone to take charge, build a base and wipe out the Nod forces. That's where you come in.

Locate the Nod base and use whatever means necessary to destroy it.
missions.title: Tutorial Mission 2

missions.briefing:
As a new Commander under General Morgan, your lack of command experience merits only the most simple of tasks.

A GDI facility on the Serbian-Romanian border functions as a logistics lifeline for several other bases in the region. Take a small force and wipe the facility from the face of the earth.

Move quickly - once you arrive in the area, the GDI base will be sure to request reinforcements from the immediate vicinity.
missions.title: SE #1: Attention Seeker

missions.briefing:
We need to relieve some of the pressure on Brotherhood forces elsewhere. You will get the locals to do the dirty work for us.

Your destruction of the GDI logistics facility has forced GDI to reallocate many of their forces along the Serbian-Romanian border. This redeployment has noticeably lowered GDI military strength near the town of Sinaia, where many important local officials holiday. Sinaia is relatively isolated, and as of late, relies on supplies in the form of humanitarian convoys.

This gives us a chance to tarnish GDI's reputation with the locals. Use buggies and bikes to seize control of the mountain roads and make sure the population of Sinaia never eats again.
missions.title: SE #2: The Humanitarian Crisis

missions.briefing:
GDI has publicly committed to setting up a new base near Bucharest. Their MCV will travel through the city of Brasov - a perfect interception point.

Using our trained hijackers, capture GDI's MCV, then use GDI equipment to ravage the city of Brasov's important institutions and cultural monuments.

You will need to deal with the local military presence - however, their very defeat here at the hands of "GDI" should twist public opinion in our favor.
missions.title: SE #3: False Eagle

missions.briefing:
Materials and equipment vital to the war effort have been stockpiled at a Brotherhood port on the Danube. While the port has survived one assault, it is still in danger of falling into GDI hands.

You must ensure that the supplies stored there escape GDI's encirclement. Defend the port and escort our supply ships to safety downriver.

Contact was lost with other, smaller outposts in the area, and some of our troops are also still retreating towards the port facility. You may be able to make use of these assets, but ultimately - consider them expendable.
missions.title: SE #4: Shakedown

missions.briefing:
GDI forces are storming our bases across the region. You are being assigned to the defense of a critical research and development laboratory.

You are not expected to defeat GDI. A train is en route to the lab, and will be used to extract vital personnel and prototypes. Your sole objective is to hold the line until the train arrives.

Protect the lab by any means necessary. No cost is too great.
missions.title: SE #5: Talons' Grasp

missions.briefing:
While our most experimental technologies remain outside of GDI's grasp, your Mobile HQ was cut off from the bulk of our forces in the aftermath of the last operation, and is still within range of GDI's main offensive line.

To make matters worse, our corporate suppliers have decided that now is the time to stem the flow of vehicles they have so 'generously' supplied the Brotherhood with. Their mercenary company, Vanguard, blocks the only way out of GDI's encirclement; no doubt, they are hoping to earn favor in the changed political climate.

You must break through Vanguard's lines and escape GDI's clutches. No other outcome is acceptable.
missions.title: SE #6: Reduction in Force

missions.briefing:
With corporate support withdrawn from the Brotherhood, most of our arsenal is now ripe for inspection and reverse-engineering. We cannot afford to let corporations - or worse, GDI - analyze and reproduce our unique equipment on a mass scale.

While the majority of our forces continue their retreat to General Korkut's positions in Anatolia, you will take a small infiltration team into a corporate facility patrolled by Vanguard. While the base was formerly used to deliver vehicles to our Airstrips, it also functions as a centralized data store for schematics that our suppliers no longer have permission to use.

Get the Engineer to each of the three data terminals so he can obtain root access to the facility's data system. Once access is obtained, we will upload something that will destroy not just the Brotherhood's data, but the entire network.
missions.title: SE #7: Infringement

missions.briefing:
The GDI navy has blockaded the Bosporus, preventing us from crossing over to Anatolia. Our boats stand no chance against GDI warships. We need to level the playing field.

An old but still-active Russian submarine base is hidden somewhere near Sevastopol. In addition to conventional subs, it's rumored to hold an experimental nuclear missile submarine. Regardless of whether or not that's true, we can still use the rest of the subs to bolster our forces.

Take a small task force and capture the Russian Black Sea Fleet HQ to pinpoint the submarine base's location. Once done, a second team will be deployed to take control of the base and retrieve the subs.
missions.title: SE #8: Five-Finger Discount

missions.briefing:
The Bosporus Strait - the last obstacle between your troops and freedom from the shackles of GDI's relentless onslaught.

Navigation through the strait itself is straightforward, but GDI has positioned warships throughout.

The submarines stolen from the Russians should, however, give you the element of surprise. GDI's vessels will find themselves at the bottom of the ocean before they can so much as call for reinforcements.

Once GDI's navy has met its demise and the path is clear, it will be time to cross the strait.

Your ace in the hole, Project 941, must remain intact. The submarine has not yet been outfitted with the nuclear munitions it is designed to launch, but you cannot afford to let such a potentially powerful tool sink below the waves.
missions.title: SE #9: Emergence

missions.briefing:
Anatolia was supposed to be a safe haven, but it turns out General Korkut never intended for you to arrive on these shores alive.

Only one course of action remains. Rally the loyal supporters you've brought with you from exile. Prove to the rest of Nod that the spirit hand of Kane guides you - and not the traitor Korkut.
missions.title: SE #10: Mercurial

missions.briefing:
Like the loyal bloodhound that he is, General Howard is prepared to follow you to the ends of the earth. Already his forces muster on Anatolian shores, prepared to drive on your new Temple, while those of his Russian allies approach not far behind.

Good.

It's time to put an end to the chase once and for all. Project 941 is currently being armed with nuclear warheads. Stall Howard until Project 941 comes online, then use it to obliterate Howard's command center and bury him in the rubble.

Do not allow the destruction of your temple. Annihilate any enemy forces that get in your way.
missions.title: SE #11: Pale Horse

missions.briefing:
The Brotherhood of Nod co-opts our message of resistance to Western imperialism across our country. Those who are not swayed by Nod's messaging are intimidated by their actions. We must act against the pretenders.

We have word that Nod intends to send assassins after an influential village strongman by the name of Mayardit. Take what scant forces we have in the region and protect him from the Brotherhood.
missions.title: PTTP #1: Shielding the Strongman

missions.briefing:
Our local connections have informed us that a large number of sympathetic fighters are being held in a GDI prison. Unfortunately, there is also a sizable contingent of prisoners that are pro-Nod, and the Brotherhood is moving towards the base with haste.

We must be the ones to grant freedom to those trapped inside. A small contingent of troops has been dispatched to the area. Capture the prison before Nod can muster enough forces to overcome the GDI defenses.
missions.title: PTTP #2: Friends of the People

missions.briefing:
Our country's biggest demographic groups have aligned themselves with the giants occupying our homeland. Two historic villages sit on the front lines, poised to be destroyed when the conflagration spreads.

This situation presents us with the opportunity for a major propaganda coup. If you can sweep in and destroy both GDI and Nod's presence in the area, we might be able to win the hearts of the people in a way not yet seen.
missions.title: PTTP #3: Between Two Stones

missions.briefing:
Recent victories have ensured the loyalty of the populace and a steady supply of recruits to our cause. Unfortunately, we are still desperately short on both funds and military hardware. We need to solve these issues if we are to expel the occupiers.

We have slipped a small taskforce into a valley where the Brotherhood prepares to mount an assault on a major GDI airbase. The valley is rich in Tiberium wealth; harvest as much as you need to meet the fundraising quota, but try to minimize your expenses.

While we have engaged GDI with vigor in previous battles, this base is of critical importance to them, and we cannot afford to bring down the eagle's full force upon us just yet. Do not attack the GDI positions. Instead, focus on destroying Nod's SAM Sites. We have reliable intel that the local A-10 colonel prefers soft targets.
missions.title: PTTP #4: In the Cage

missions.briefing:
GDI is attempting to move a nuclear detonator through our country, and our agents inside the Brotherhood's local operations tell us that Nod intends to steal it. We have no use for the weapon itself; it is impractical from both a military and a political perspective. However, certain parties in the former USSR would be extremely interested in such a device, and they would pay us a pretty penny for it.

We will therefore hijack the Brotherhood's heist attempt. We know that they plan to launch the raid from a nearby Nod base, although we don't know exactly where. We also need more information on the route Nod plans to exfiltrate the detonator through. Your first task will be to capture a nearby Communications Center and obtain this intelligence. Once you have said intelligence, standby for further orders.

Needless to say, GDI must know nothing of our activities here - they will almost certainly launch a campaign against us if they believe we were involved with the theft of the detonator. You must not engage or be engaged by GDI troops. Let them believe the Brotherhood is the sole party responsible.
missions.title: PTTP #5: Sleight of Hand

missions.briefing:
We've delivered the Tiberium you harvested and the detonator you stole to our Communist contacts in the former USSR. In exchange, they have agreed to provide us with substantial stockpiles of military equipment, as well as the means to manufacture that equipment for ourselves. This deal will dramatically shift the tide of the war.

Unfortunately, our logistics center has become bogged down in a fiasco. While the first major shipment from Europe arrived without issue, the second has yet to show, and Nod has launched an assault on the facility. To make matters worse, despite our efforts to avoid antagonizing GDI, the eagle is also focused on the facility's destruction. There are murmurings among the Liberation Council that our previous strategy was a mistake. Some even say it was treason.

You must take control at the logistics site and immediately put the situation in order. Defend your position until the second shipment from Europe arrives. Then use our new weapons to wipe all foreign occupiers from the region.
missions.title: PTTP #6: Part and Parcel

missions.briefing:
Our military forces are stronger than ever with the integration of new equipment from Europe. However, our leadership is divided and tensions are high due to the near-disaster at the logistics center, which occurred despite our best efforts to avoid antagonizing GDI.

It's been decided by a slim margin that you will retaliate against the GDI imperialists. While the majority of our forces organize for a larger, decisive offensive, you will take a small contingent and lead a campaign of terror.

GDI forces recently expelled the Brotherhood from this region. Your mission is simple - expel GDI as well.
missions.title: PTTP #7: Community Property

missions.briefing:
Around the country, our forces mobilize for the final, critical strike. However, your recent confrontation with GDI has proven that the enemy's new Mammoth Tanks are still providing their forces with a decisive edge in combat.

Luckily, there is an opportunity for us to neutralize these behemoths before our offensive begins. The imperialists have been foolish enough to concentrate their Mammoth Tank production at a single facility in-country. While the security in and around the base is intense, captured GDI soldiers indicate that the security inside the factories themselves is lax. You will exploit this opportunity.

Capture the Weapons Factories, but do not let GDI discover your presence. We will turn their own weapons against them.

There is also a Nod base in the area - eliminate its production facilities. We cannot afford to let the Brotherhood jeopardize this operation.
missions.title: PTTP #8: Seeds of Dissent

missions.briefing:
We are finally in a position to drive out the occupiers completely. Across the country, our well-equipped forces are prepared to partake in a final offensive that will annihilate GDI and Nod military power across multiple regions simultaneously.

As the most accomplished of our commanders, you have been given the most important responsibility of all -- crushing GDI's largest stronghold, which houses their Ion Cannon uplink and many of their air assets. The Brotherhood has erected a Temple nearby in a desperate effort to re-assert their importance, and must also be ground to dust.

Your victory here will demoralize the armies of the eagle and the scorpion, and signal our forces elsewhere that it is time to launch the rest of the offensive campaign. It all depends on you, Comrade. Glory to the revolution!
missions.title: PTTP #9: All Fall Down

missions.briefing:
A civil war is brewing in a post-Soviet state. A faction of radical Communists, disappointed with the development of the country after the dissolution of the Soviet Union, has taken up arms and is prepared to overthrow the legal Government.

You have been assigned as a new Commander to counter this threat. As your first task, you are to capture a local radio station that the Communists are using to broadcast propaganda to the people, followed by eliminating the nearby military base that the Communists have re-commissioned.

Can you crush the revolt? Are you willing to do so?

Get ready for a massive campaign with a branching storyline driven by cutscenes, and over 30 missions to play.
missions.title: CR#01: Suppression

missions.briefing:
The destruction of the recommissioned Soviet base, while a significant victory, wasn't enough to quench the rebellion, and our enemy is building up a new base. While we could do another direct assault, we believe we can render this base inoperable with fewer casualties.

GDI has proposed that they could take out the communists' Construction Yard with an air strike. However, the enemy has SAM batteries around their base perimeter. GDI wants the ground cleared of these anti-air defenses before they execute the air strike.

Take control of a Commando and use him to destroy the SAM sites. The enemy has a limited quantity of heavy armor and anti-infantry weaponry, such as Quad Tanks. For these, we - with GDI's help - have provided you with a base that can produce a limited number of Orca aircraft. Use them to take out any vehicles that are too much for the Commando to handle.

The south of the area has a village with a church whose priest has been loyal to us. He might be able to give you more information about the enemy's movements.
missions.title: CR#02: Covert Strike

missions.briefing:
We felt we were close to defeating the communist rebels, but they suddenly strengthened their forces and conquered a major industrial zone. The zone contains oil refinement facilities, and by controlling those facilities they are stealing our oil income. They have forced the industrial workers to work for them as well.

Using their new resources, they've sieged and assaulted our base in the zone. The defense is on its last legs and must be reinforced at once. Take control of the reinforcements and smash the sieging units. If you're successful, we'll give you control of the base. Afterwards, you must retake our industry and crush the communist bases in the area. Keep an eye out for anything that could explain the sudden military power spike of the resistance.
missions.title: CR#03: Retake the Industrial Area

missions.briefing:
Due to the chemical attacks perpetrated by the enemy during our last operation, the Global Defense Initiative has started looking more seriously into the conflict. They have determined that a faction of the Brotherhood of Nod is already providing the Communists with limited military support and assisting with the modernization of their equipment.

Our combined intelligence services have learned that Nod is transferring another supply of modern weapons to the Soviets, carrying the weapons on trucks through a forested rural area. GDI has suggested a plan that they could bomb those supply trucks, but they're unable to precisely track the trucks without eyes on the ground.

Take a Commando and move him to a hill that allows observation of a road that we suspect the trucks will cross. Once the trucks arrive, he'll signal the GDI A-10s that it's time.

Once the trucks are confirmed destroyed, return him back to our outpost.
missions.title: CR#04: Obstruction

missions.briefing:
We've suffered a heavy setback. The enemy managed to protect their weapon supplies, and while our forces were distracted, they launched an assault elsewhere.

GDI had a Tiberium research and containment unit here that they were expanding into a full base to counter the recently surfaced Nod threat. Nod must've learned about GDI's plans in advance as they performed a sudden strike and overtook the work-in-progress GDI base, which they are now sharing with the Communists.

Our forces, assisted by GDI units, have been sent in units to reinforce the area and take the base back. Unfortunately, it hasn't been enough, and the situation has descended into a chaotic meat grinder.

We're relying on you to solve this mess left by GDI incompetence. Use your forces to retake an important bridgehead. If you succeed, we'll send you an MCV. Use it to build up a base and destroy the enemies.
missions.title: CR#05: Riposte

missions.briefing:
Our enemy has set up positions in a large lake area, but we need to take back more of the shoreline before we can attack them.

We've lost contact with our base in the area, but we don't expect it to be entirely gone. According to our scouts, the supply route there should be safe too.

Reinforce the base with a group of forces; you should be able to reach the base without encountering resistance. Afterwards, bring the base's communications back online and destroy the enemy's facilities on the eastern islands.

The Soviets have reportedly set up anti-ship cannons on the north-western shore, and those are preventing GDI from moving their ships. While not the primary objective, take out those shore defenses if you can spare the resources to do so.
missions.title: CR#06: Forward Momentum

missions.briefing:
Our successful attack has left the enemy slightly shocked. Despite this, our enemy seems to have more resources than they logically should, with the Commies having both more equipment and more men than our data indicates. GDI is equally puzzled by this discrepancy.

We want to exploit our momentum and look for the source of enemy strength. We will send a spy to infiltrate a command center they have on a nearby archipelago. With luck, they might've not managed to wipe the data - our progress has been that quick.

After successful infiltration, we'll analyze any data found. We'll adjust your mission objectives based on what we discover. We are also ready to send you a limited amount of additional forces if necessary.

Objective: Infiltrate the Soviet Forward Command Center.
briefing_objectives: Infiltrate the Soviet Forward Command Center.
missions.title: CR#07: Snowhopper

missions.briefing:
When Nod publicly surfaced in our country, they quickly launched a joint assault with the Communists on a major heavy vehicle factory and established control over it. Since then, there has been constant back-and-forth battle over the factory, with the factory pumping out tanks by the dozen for the enemy. We've also noticed increased Tiberium growth in the area, which we suspect Nod has something to do with.

We need to capture this factory, and we need your forces to help with the task. Traverse the ice path and use your Enforcer to block the factory's primary supply route, preventing the factory's operation. If you succeed, we'll send you an MCV. Afterwards, set up a base and destroy all enemy bases on the mainland.

It is critical that no supplies get through to the factory even once you have a base. Otherwise, the enemy will be able to produce large swaths of combat vehicles from there. Produce infantry from your Enforcer to support the blockade as necessary.
missions.title: CR#08: The Cleaver

missions.briefing:
Despite conquering the factory, we haven't been able to make much progress. Our GDI-backed forces are somewhat superior in strength, but as we've pushed forward, our support routes have become longer.

Just like earlier against you, Nod has exploited this in full by assaulting our logistics with "Ezekiel's Wheels" - Stealth Tanks. Our troops have been left starved for support as no harvester or supply truck has been safe from this menace.

To solve this problem, GDI has given us some of their new Sensor Arrays. These can detect Nod Stealth Tanks from a distance and help us protect our backline. To make sure we get them to the front safely, we need your forces to escort the Sensor Arrays to our base.

Your objective is simple: Bring the Sensor Arrays to safety.
missions.title: CR Route A #09: Sensory Escort

missions.briefing:
Our new Sensor Arrays have helped us make progress on the frontline again, but the enemy accumulated significant resources while we were stalled.

Nod and the Communist scum have artificially allowed Tiberium to poison our land as much as possible, and now they are harvesting this Tiberium to fund the war.

To put pressure on their Tiberium harvesting operations, we need you to take and hold a valley near some fresh Tiberium fields. Make a landing there, establish a base, and hold the position. This operation is risky, but if successful, we will have opened another front against the enemy.

According to GDI intel, the enemy is not expecting this move, giving you a good opportunity to scout the area and build your base after landing. Make sure to use the time to establish a foothold before the enemy detects your forces.

Objective 1: Deploy your MCV and start building a base.
Objective 2: Defend your base until the enemy's main offensive potential has been exhausted.
briefing_objectives: Deploy your MCV and start building a base.
Defend your base until the enemy's main offensive potential has been exhausted.
missions.title: CR Route A #10: Tiberium Denial

missions.briefing:
Your earlier operation forced the enemy to divert significant resources away from the primary front. This redeployment, along with a new batch of vehicles given to us by GDI, allows us to launch a strong assault on the Communist frontline.

Use your forces to clear out smaller enemy outposts on both sides of a river. Once done, we'll send you MCVs. Use them to build bases on the sites of the enemy outposts.

Afterwards, continue pushing eastward on both sides of the river until there is no more resistance.

We expect the enemy is ready to reinforce the area in the event of your success. Expect battles to be heavy.

Objective 1: Destroy the neo-Soviet outposts on both sides of the river.

Objective 2: Destroy all enemy bases.
briefing_objectives: Destroy the neo-Soviet outposts on both sides of the river.
Destroy all enemy bases.
missions.title: CR Route A #11: Pincer Movement

missions.briefing:
Our previous operation was harder than expected due to an unexpected quantity of enemy reinforcements. However, the diversion of those enemy troops left the garrison of Karhumäki thin. This gives us an opportunity.

Take command of a group of elite soldiers and take them to a local bus driver. He will get them to the city center. Capture a civilian radar and hold it, allowing us to push our propaganda out to the civilians.

Then, we will deliver you a second batch of elite soldiers. Use them to destroy the SAM systems near a railway, allowing GDI bombers to destroy Tesla Coils from there.

Afterwards, we will deliver you vehicles and engineers by train. Destroy the Soviet military infrastructure in the city, and finally, capture the City Council building.

- Objective 1: Board the civilian bus. Once at its destination, capture the civilian radar and hold it.
- Objective 2: Destroy the SAM sites guarding the railway's anti-ground defenses.
- Objective 3: Destroy all Soviet Forward Command Centers in the city area.
- Objective 4: Capture the City Council building.
- Optional: Destroy all Nod bases.
briefing_objectives: Board the civilian bus. Once at its destination, capture the civilian radar and hold it.
Destroy the SAM sites guarding the railway's anti-ground defenses.
Destroy all Soviet Forward Command Centers in the city area.
Capture the City Council building.
missions.title: CR Route A #12: Counter-Revolt

missions.briefing:
With our victory at Karhumäki, the Communist frontline quickly collapsed. The next step is continuing on from the city to reclaim our border area, which is used by the enemy to receive foreign mercenaries that strengthen their lines.

Take a group of forces, set up a base, and smash the enemy infrastructure on the border river to the southwest. Destroy their barracks and the bridges that lead to Russia. With the barracks and bridges gone, they will no longer be able to receive infantry and other supplies from the Russian Communist movement.

Objective: Destroy the bridges and Soviet buildings on the eastern riverside.

You now have access to the Missile Tank, created by removing the Chronosphere from defunct Allied Chrono Tanks and instead fitting in a rotating turret. Like the Chrono Tank, the Missile Tank is very effective against enemy tanks, but lightly armored, so keep it away from enemy infantry and artillery.
briefing_objectives: Destroy the bridges and Soviet buildings on the eastern riverside.
missions.title: CR Route A #13: Breaking a Path

missions.briefing:
This is it, Commander. Our final victory is at hand.

The leadership of the Communist scum has escaped here, to the last known Nod base on our territory. Nod is not allowing the Communists to flee further, but is instead forcing them to make their final stand.

Destroy the Communists and their Brotherhood friends. Leave no ruin standing. Nod has prepared for this battle, and we don't know what they have done with the technology they captured from us and the GDI. Be ready for strong resistance.

If you find any special buildings of interest in the Nod bases, be sure to infiltrate them. As this area contains the headquarters of the local Nod group of forces, there could be information that is useful to us.
missions.title: CR Route A #14 (Finale): Crushed Revolt

missions.briefing:
You need to perform investigation of Government activities to check whether the performed atrocities were intentionally ordered by the high command, or whether they have been instead performed on the initiative of individual units.

This will tell you whether you need to act against the high command, or only seek punishment for the individual units. In case things go bad, some evidence would surely be helpful to shift the opinion of GDI, as well as your own troops.

From some initial investigation during military leadership meetings, you've learned that a Tech Center in the heart of Government territory hosts communication data between different Government officials. Infiltrate the Tech Center with a Spy. Once inside, find a terminal that contains the communications data. Copy the data, then get back to the entry point.

Avoid dog patrols on the way, they can detect your Spy!

- Objective 1: Infiltrate the Tech Center in the Government base.

- Objective 2: Grab the communication data from the console.

- Objective 3: Get back to the car at the entry point.
briefing_objectives: Infiltrate the Tech Center in the Government base.
Grab the communication data from the console.
Get back to the car at the entry point.
missions.title: CR Route B #09: Investigation

missions.briefing:
Your announcement of an uprising has led to total chaos in the Government military. Some units have decided to follow you, while others have stayed loyal to Ivanov.

You yourself are in danger, as units in a nearby base are divided in their support. It is necessary to make the situation clearer, to organize your supporters into a safe area for coordination of further operations.

Get your Mobile HQ across a bridge to the southwest into territory that is controlled by units loyal to you. There will be both friendly and hostile units along the way. Use the friendly units to protect your Mobile HQ.

Objective: Get the Mobile HQ across the river to the southwest. The Mobile HQ (you) must survive.
briefing_objectives: Get the Mobile HQ across the river to the southwest. The Mobile HQ (you) must survive.
missions.title: CR Route B #10: Flight

missions.briefing:
To win against Ivanov, you need your own industrial base. Capturing one of the country's most important industrial areas would be a good start.

Rendezvous with a nearby outpost of Government forces who have pledged loyalty to you. Once the outpost is under your control, proceed to build a force, take over a local Government War Factory and build a Mobile Construction Vehicle.

Use the MCV to build up a base, then build more forces and destroy Government bases in the area. Remember to expand to keep your economy up.

- Objective 1: Rendezvous with the friendly outpost.

- Objective 2: Take over a Government War Factory and build an MCV to set up a proper base.

- Objective 3: Destroy all Government factories.
briefing_objectives: Rendezvous with the friendly outpost.
Take over a Government War Factory and build an MCV to set up a proper base.
Destroy all Government factories.
missions.title: CR Route B #11: Confiscation

missions.briefing:
GDI wants to perform a landing to establish a clear supply line to the country. However, Ivanov's forces have heavily fortified the most optimal shoreline for a landing. To establish a beachhead with as few casualties as possible, you need to cut the power to the Government AA guns.

Take control of a Commando and bring him to a weapons cache that a defector in the Government military has prepared for you. Once you have grabbed the weapons, find your way into the Government power facility and blow the place up.

After the AA guns have lost their power, a GDI air raid will commence and clear out the Government anti-naval defenses. Afterwards you will receive a landing force. Use the included MCV to build up a base, and destroy all Government forces.

- Objective 1: Pick up the ammo crates in the southwest.
- Objective 2: Find your way into the Government power facility and destroy it.
- Objective 3: Perform a landing and set up a base.
- Objective 4: Destroy all Government factories.
briefing_objectives: Pick up the ammo crates in the southwest.
Find your way into the Government power facility and destroy it.
Perform a landing and set up a base.
Destroy all Government factories.
missions.title: CR Route B #12: The Eagle Has Landed

missions.briefing:
With the leadership of the country shattered by the battle between you and Ivanov, Nod and the neo-Soviets have exploited the situation. They have broken through the frontline and are rushing to take more territory. Some of the Government forces are resisting, but others are surrendering and even defecting to the Brotherhood.

Reinforce the area with a group of units and stop the progress of the enemy. Build up a base and destroy all Nod, Communist and defected Government forces.

The area still has some Government outposts that are hostile to Nod, but their forces are running low. Perhaps they might be willing to join forces with you if you reinforce them before Nod has taken them out.

Objective: Destroy all Nod, Soviet and defected Government forces.
briefing_objectives: Destroy all Nod, Soviet and defected Government forces.
missions.title: CR Route B #13: Rebalance

missions.briefing:
Despite our defensive victory, the combined threat of Nod and the neo-Soviets is not gone. To achieve more permanent results, we need to counterattack and push the front further.

Take a heavy force and crush the enemy's frontline. If we win here, we will be at the gates of Karhumaki, which is where the neo-Soviet leadership is hosted.

The enemy has had time to fortify the area, so expect heavy resistance.

Objective: Destroy all Nod and neo-Soviet forces.
briefing_objectives: Destroy all Nod and neo-Soviet forces.
missions.title: CR Route B #14: Battering Ram

missions.briefing:
We established an outpost on a tactically significant hill that provides control over the remaining frontline between Nod, the neo-Soviets and Ivanov's Government.

This proved to be a mistake as Nod attacked and besieged the outpost. They have built SAM sites to prevent us from supplying the base, and their attacks have crippled our production.

Take a force of elite soldiers and destroy the SAM sites, allowing us to restore operation of the base. Afterwards, destroy all enemy forces - whether they are of Nod, Government or Soviet origin.

- Objective 1: Destroy the SAM sites around the GDI base.

- Objective 2: Destroy all enemy forces.
briefing_objectives: Destroy the SAM sites around the GDI base.
Destroy all enemy forces.
missions.title: CR Route B #15: Epicenter

missions.briefing:
It has come time to finish off Ivanov and his forces. He has heavily fortified his remaining territory, the swampy terrain is challenging to navigate around, and he has preserved his most loyal and best trained units for this moment. Be prepared for a long battle.

Infiltrate Ivanov's defenses with an infantry group and eliminate AA guns along both sides of a river. Once done, we will send you aerial reinforcements. Assault a Government outpost with them and destroy an ammo stash inside.

Afterwards, we will send you a vehicle force. Breach Ivanov's first defensive line to receive an MCV. Set up your base, build up a force, and destroy all of Ivanov's production facilities to end his tyranny once and for all.
missions.title: CR Route B #16: Valiant Revolt

missions.briefing:
The final fight is upon us. Only the forces of the Brotherhood of Nod remain in your way. They have prepared heavy defensive positions and have empowered their arsenal with technology from the Soviets, Government forces, and even GDI.

Our forces are attacking their frontline, but they are having a hard time breaking through. While those forces have the full attention of the enemy, use some Chinooks to bypass the Nod lines and bring your units across a lake.

Afterwards, establish a base and destroy all enemy forces. Good luck, Commander.

- Objective 1: Build a base. It is recommended that you establish it across the lake for ease of collecting Tiberium.
- Objective 2: Destroy all enemy forces.

- Optional: If you find any special buildings in the Nod bases, capture them to potentially find information that could be of interest to us.
briefing_objectives: Build a base. It is recommended that you establish it across the lake for ease of collecting Tiberium.
Destroy all enemy forces.
missions.title: CR Route B #17 (Finale): Expel the Interloper

missions.briefing:
GDI has stopped supporting us. We could surrender to them or to the Communists, but that would be the end for all of us, or at least our pride and self-esteem.

Instead, we are pressing on by ourselves. The problem is, our forces are inferior in strength to the combined forces of the Communists and Nod. To solve this disparity, we will take over one of the Communist bases and turn their own vehicles against them.

Attack either the western or the eastern Soviet base and capture their critical buildings. The western one is smaller and has lighter defenses, meaning it is easier to capture. The eastern one instead carries more risk, but also a higher prize.

Afterwards, expand, take control of the area, and eradicate all resistance.

- Objective 1: Attack one of the Communist bases and capture their critical structures.

- Objective 2: Destroy all enemy factories.
briefing_objectives: Attack one of the Communist bases and capture their critical structures.
Destroy all enemy factories.
missions.title: CR Route C #09: Act on Desperation

missions.briefing:
Your successful attack surprised the whole world, and with it, also our enemies. Their forces have been thrown into disarray. This gives us an opportunity to quickly make further gains.

The Communists are trying to build a defensive line on a river to block our advance. Such an obstacle would prevent us from pressing further. We need to strike before their plans are realized.

Take a group of fast vehicles and rush down all Nod and Soviet factories on the southwestern side of the river. Do not engage heavy enemy vehicles - our forces are not equipped for that. Instead, focus purely on the bases and, if necessary, their immediate defenders.

If you succeed, we will send you an MCV, cross the river before the enemy can react, and deploy it on the northeastern side of the river. Build up a base and destroy all Nod and Communist forces on the northeastern side of the river as well.

- Objective 1: Rush the Nod outposts and the Soviet base and destroy all factories.
- Objective 2: Destroy all enemy bases.
briefing_objectives: Rush the Nod outposts and the Soviet base and destroy all factories.
Destroy all enemy bases.
missions.title: CR Route C #10: Blitzkrieg

missions.briefing:
Your successful blitzkrieg has completely collapsed the Communist defensive lines. However, they still have a heavy garrison in the city of Karhumäki. To smash through it, we will need to resort to unusual equipment: the Battle Rig.

Take a Spy and use it to infiltrate a Forward Command Center in a neo-Soviet outpost. We will exploit the current chaos and the quick collapse of lines and trick the Communists into allowing our train inside their base.

The train will contain infantry that you can use to take over the base and capture any important buildings. Once the base is secured, we will start assembling the Battle Rig from parts in the train. We are not expecting any major enemy forces, but you will need to defend the train until the Battle Rig is ready.

- Objective 1: Infiltrate the Forward Command Center.

- Objective 2: Defend the train until the Battle Rig is ready.
briefing_objectives: Infiltrate the Forward Command Center.
Defend the train until the Battle Rig is ready.
missions.title: CR Route C #11: Trojan Train

missions.briefing:
It has come time to destroy the headquarters of the Communist scum. To make an example of them for anyone opposing us and to send a message to GDI, we also need to destroy the city of Karhumäki. Kill everyone and destroy everything that you come across. Any civilian still living there after almost a year of Communist rule is a traitor anyway: we will not miss them.

Take control of the Battle Rig and destroy the neo-Soviet base to the northeast of your entry point. Once successful, we will send you an MCV. Build up a base, strengthen your forces, and raze down the city.

- Objective 1: Destroy the Soviet base to the northeast of the entry point.

- Objective 2: Destroy the city of Karhumäki.
briefing_objectives: Destroy the Soviet base to the northeast of the entry point.
Destroy the city of Karhumäki.
missions.title: CR Route C #12: The Massacre

missions.briefing:
The Global Defense Initiative has launched a full-scale attack on us.

Ivanov has, at least as far as you have understood, requested you to pull all of your forces back to his headquarters to defend.

Set up a base and defend Ivanov's main base against the GDI invasion. Build up a sizable force and push back - counterattack and destroy the GDI forces.

Trying to defend Toikka's and Ivanov's secondary bases is optional, but might be beneficial for the success of the operation.

It's do or die time. If you fail here, it's all over for you.

- Objective 1: Keep Ivanov's southwestern base operational.

- Objective 2: Destroy all GDI forces.
briefing_objectives: Keep Ivanov's southwestern base operational.
Destroy all GDI forces.
missions.title: CR Route C #13: The Eagle's Claws

missions.briefing:
Despite our initial defensive success, GDI has not stopped their assault yet.

We assigned Toikka to personally defend the ruined factory area to keep at least some resemblance of a frontline intact. However, he lost most of his positions to a GDI assault and had to retreat to the factory island. Now his forces are besieged and attacked from ground, air and water.

Send your remaining forces there and push GDI out, preferably with Toikka still alive.

Nod has also built an outpost in the area and they are having trouble with the GDI forces as well. We now have a ceasefire with Nod. If you can keep their outpost intact, it could pave the way for greater collaboration against GDI.

Objective: Destroy all GDI bases.

Optional 1: Keep the eastern Nod outpost functional.

Optional 2: Prevent Toikka's base on the factory island from getting destroyed.
briefing_objectives: Destroy all GDI bases.
missions.title: CR Route C #14: The Eagle's Beak

missions.briefing:
GDI failed to destroy us with their offensive, but they are still not retreating. There is significant popular backlash for the failed GDI offense - we have to exploit this opportunity to further make GDI's supporters tired of war, hopefully forcing GDI to retreat.

We shall attack a shoreline that GDI first occupied when they attacked us. They have set up significant logistical infrastructure here to support their troops. If we manage to take out their bases here, GDI will have a hard time supporting their remaining land forces, which should pressure the GDI leadership into re-evaluating their attack on us.

Objective: Destroy all GDI bases.
briefing_objectives: Destroy all GDI bases.
missions.title: CR Route C #15 (Finale): Off the Plank

missions.briefing:
It has come time for you to replace Ivanov. It is expected that he is hiding in his largest military base, the same one that GDI attacked earlier. If you destroy his forces here, he will have nothing left to oppose you with.

According to your spies, Ivanov has set up special radars here to trace the physical location of your HQ. It is unknown what he would do with your location, but it's best to destroy the radars just in case, preferably before their trace is completed.

Objective: Destroy Ivanov's forces. If Toikka's forces still remain after the factory siege, destroy them as well.
briefing_objectives: Destroy Ivanov's forces. If Toikka's forces still remain after the factory siege, destroy them as well.
missions.title: CR Route C #16 (Alt. Finale): Your Revolt

missions.briefing:
We have located a Nod island base where they took the MCVs they stole from us. This island base is controlled by the special "Pink Menace" sub-unit of Nod. They have previously performed only limited operations against us, like surgical airstrikes, stealth tank attacks, and attacks using stolen technology.

According to our intelligence, Nod resistance here should be light, though we haven't seen this unit of Nod fight us in full capacity before, so stay alert.

Make an amphibious landing to the island, build up a base and units as necessary, and wipe out all Nod production facilities that you come across. In addition to regular ground forces, you will also need to make use of naval units due to the island-heavy terrain.

Objective: Destroy all Nod factories.

NOTE: It is recommended that you have completed both Route A and Route B before attempting this mission.
briefing_objectives: Destroy all Nod factories.
missions.title: CR Bonus Mission: The Pink Menace

missions.briefing: As a highly-respected GDI commander, you're about to participate in the planning of GDI's future strategy. However, your private plane gets shot down, and while fighting for survival you find that you're now the test target of Nod's new, deadly weapons...
missions.title: TTD #1: Lost Position

missions.briefing:
Your base got devastated by some new Tiberium-based multi-missile after Nod failed to destroy it by other means. The missile started spreading dangerous tiberium veins and gas all around the base, and with the damage it dealt you couldn't have held the base for much longer. So, the only possible way to survive was running away.

With the base gone, the area is now strictly controlled by Nod. However, there should be some GDI outposts nearby which could possibly give you some more forces in your disposal. Nod is also using civilians in the area for some weapon testing, if you'd help them they'd surely be grateful.

Your main objective is gathering a force large enough to break through Nod's defences to the North. Go there as far as you can until you get to GDI's territory.
missions.title: TTD #2: The Breakthrough

missions.briefing:
After breaking through Nod's roadblock, a small GDI group came to save you. Now you're safe in the GDI base, but Nod has been expanding very aggressively in the area and you must destroy the Nod base in the area to halt their expanding.

We've heard reports that Nod might be bringing new weapons into the area. The civilian village in the sector might be friendly or unfriendly towards you, we don't know their exact stance. Try to keep them safe if possible, and don't annoy them.

Your only objective is: Destroy the Nod base.
missions.title: TTD #3: The Frontal Duel

missions.briefing:
We're in front of Nod's main source of Tiberium Waste, which they're using for creating destructive chemical missiles. We must stop their production at once, and obviously the only way to do that is destroying their production facility.

Thanks to you taking out their chemical lab in the earlier area, we have managed to delay Nod's chemical weapon deployments until now. However, Nod has continued their research and production here and our time is running short. If completed, these missiles would change the tide of the battle in a way that we wouldn't be able to recover from.

Destroy Nod's Temple before they can finalize the first set of missiles!
missions.title: TTD #4 Finale A: The Toxic Time Trial

missions.briefing:
We're in front of Nod's main source of Tiberium Waste, which they're using for creating destructive chemical missiles. We must stop their production at once, and obviously the only way to do that is destroying their production facility.

Nod has already prepared a set of experimental missiles that they're ready to use against you. They will cause heavy damage and our casualties will be high, but if we don't stop them now, their missile technology will only get deadlier due time.

This is our last chance to go all-in and wipe out this facility now! This battle will be difficult, but we'll be sending you as many reinforcements as possible.
missions.title: TTD #4 Finale B: The Rectification

missions.briefing:
After the GDI high command found out about how you slaughtered the civilians earlier, they instantly sent a force to take you out. You managed to escape with a small group of loyal followers, but most of the forces that were under your control also turned against you. Now you've gained some lead compared to the GDI forces, but another battlefield is in front of you. If GDI sees you, they'll execute you as a war criminal. Nod, on the other hand, recognizes your talent as a commander and is offering you a place in their ranks. Accepting their offer is the only means of survival. Alone you aren't a serious threat to either GDI nor Nod.

GDI is attacking the Nod base in this area extremely heavily. Nod wants you to take control of an MCV, build a base and help them defend their Temple until their set of experimental Chemical missiles is ready. Retaining control of the resource-rich center area is of extreme importance.

Accept the offer and defend the Temple until you can rain chemical death on the GDI attackers! Peace Through Power!

Or reject the offer and die. Your choice.
missions.title: TTD #4 Finale C: The Rain of Death

missions.briefing:
After the GDI high command found out about how you slaughtered the civilians earlier, they instantly sent a force to take you out. You managed to escape with a small group of loyal followers, but most of the forces that were under your control also turned against you. Now you've gained some lead compared to the GDI forces, but another battlefield is in front of you. If GDI sees you, they'll execute you as a war criminal. Nod, on the other hand, recognizes your talent as a commander and is offering you a place in their ranks. Accepting their offer is the only means of survival. Alone you aren't a serious threat to either GDI nor Nod.

GDI is attacking the Nod base in this area extremely heavily, and the Nod defenders are on their last legs. However, Nod sees a chance to strike back through with your clash with GDI. Nod wants you to take control of a special forces group and flank a northern GDI base with them, while Nod's own commanders are focused on the defense.

If you manage to destroy the base, Nod will send you an MCV that you will use to build a base and defeat GDI by conventional means.

Accept the offer and turn the tide of the desperate battle! Or reject the offer and die. Your choice.
missions.title: TTD #4 Finale D: The Conversion

missions.briefing:
We've lost contact with one of our outposts. Before it went off-line, we recieved a brief communique about giant ants. We're unsure what to make of this report, so we want you to investigate.

Scout the area, bring the outpost back on-line, and report your findings. If there is a threat, reinforcements will be sent in to help you.

Keep the base functional and radio contact open -- we don't want to lose the outpost again.
missions.title: It Came From RA! 1&2: Discovery & Rescue!

missions.briefing:
The source of the ants' activity has been pinpointed in this area. We suspect that their nests are in this area -- they must be destroyed!

A team of civilian specialists are en-route to your location. Use them to gas all the ant nests in the area. In addition, destroy all ants that you encounter.

Be careful -- these things can chew through anything. Good luck.
missions.title: It Came From RA! 3: Hunt!

missions.briefing:
We've discovered a series of tunnels underneath the ruined base. Now that we've cut off their escape routes, the ants have nowhere left to run to.

Perform a sweep and clear all of the tunnels, and find the cause of these abominations. Destroy anything that isn't human!

The power to the tunnel lights has been knocked out, which will limit visibility. Find the generator controls, and you can re-activate the lights.
missions.title: It Came From RA! 4: Exterminate!

missions.briefing: There's previously unseen enemy activity near a Soviet base. Can you investigate and eliminate the threat using the resources of a Soviet Union scattered after its defeat against Allies and the forming of the Global Defense Initiative?
missions.title: CD #1: Investigation

missions.briefing:
The enemy we recently faced is apparently known as The Brotherhood of Nod - a relatively unknown militant society. We have discovered a base and an outpost that guard a critical Nod supply transport route.

Take control of the area and destroy the base to cut off Nod's supplies.
missions.title: CD #2: Disconnect Supply Route

missions.briefing:
Our last victory gave Nod a significant setback. However, they still have a relatively large base spread over the islands in this sector. Since we cut off their support route, Nod will have nowhere to retreat from an attack.

We have already established a small base in the area. Use its facilities to build a force strong enough take out the Nod base.
missions.title: CD #3: Pulverizing

missions.briefing:
Those ships were quite an unpleasant surprise. It appears we lack the resources to fight Nod alone. Fortunately the Global Defense Initiative is offering us a helping hand. They have located another route Nod uses for transporting supplies between bases. We were unable to detect these transports because Nod has been utilizing Stealth APCs. Since our usual radars are unable to detect these vehicles, GDI has provided a Mobile Sensor Array for us. This deployable vehicle is capable of detecting the Nod stealth units.

With GDI's assistance we will intercept a large Nod stealth convoy and will destroy the APCs to deny Nod their supplies.
missions.title: CD #4: Interception

missions.briefing:
Great work on taking out the stealth tanks and supply vehicles, comrade! Now we're striking directly at the source of the problem: Nod's naval base. Defeat Nod here and their ships will no longer pose a threat in the future. Without those in the way, our victory, and your promotion, can be guaranteed.

Your objective is simple: destroy Nod's naval base.

GDI will send in ships to assist you in this operation, at least as long as their naval base stays operational.

It could be difficult to gather resources here, so it's recommended that you expand your base to multiple islands by utilizing Chinooks and 'Zubr' Hovercraft Transports.
missions.title: CD #5: Sink the Shadows

missions.briefing:
You effectively paralyzed Nod's production of units with the attack on their naval base. However, Nod still has a large amount of forces in the area, and they are not giving up.

Nod is launching a final desperate attack using all their available units in the sector in the hope of reclaiming some lost territory. We won't be able to defend against them all alone. Thankfully, GDI has once again offered us their helping hand. Their reinforcements are on the way: you will have to hold out against Nod's attacks for 70 minutes until GDI's reinforcements arrive.

Objective: Protect your Command Center against Nod for 70 minutes.
briefing_objectives: Protect your Command Center against Nod for 70 minutes.
missions.title: CD #6: A Truly Desperate Grip

missions.briefing:
GDI has betrayed us. The reinforcements they promised us never came and we were left to be crushed by an overwhelming Nod force.

Although Nod had surrounded our base for the most part, we managed to make a narrow escape to a nearby desert wasteland. Getting to the Soviet base just beyond the desert is our only means of survival.

Nod has set up defenses along pathways and sent units in pursuit. Move fast but carefully.

Objectives: 1. Get to the Soviet base beyond the desert. 2. Keep your Mobile HQ alive.
briefing_objectives: Get to the Soviet base beyond the desert.
Keep your Mobile HQ alive.
missions.title: CD #7: Flight Through the Wasteland

missions.briefing:
We can't forgive GDI's actions. They will know that they picked the wrong fight.

We'll do a surprise attack on an important GDI base located on a large island. First seize the smaller island to the south-east of the main island, then transfer your MCV to the main island, set up a base and wipe out the GDI bases in the area. Make sure they will regret their decision!
missions.title: CD #8: Retribution

missions.briefing: Free your base from Nod's siege and wipe out the enemy base in the area.
missions.title: Under Siege II

missions.briefing: The ambassador of a former Soviet state was shot down by Nod forces on his way to sign an alliance treaty. Find him before Nod does!
missions.title: Mayday

missions.briefing:
GDI has received a report of people disappearing from a village in the area. There used to be Nod activity in the area a long time ago, but we have no evidence of them being involved this time.

Take some forces and find out what's going on.
missions.title: Bunny Hunt

missions.briefing:
Commander. We are planning an assault on a large Nod installation.

Your task is to clear a construction zone so you can build a forward base. Be advised however, as soon as you are detected the enemy will be at full alert, so prepare for heavy Nod resistance.

We have reports that Nod has captured a Village in the area. We believe that they are conducting experiments on the citizens.

Your objective is to liberate the Village and destroy all Nod forces. Good luck Commander.
missions.title: Operation Curfew Breaker

missions.briefing:
One of our commanders on the African front has gone rogue. He has surrounded himself with loyalists and established a power base in the deep jungle. Shortly after he received a shipment of high-tech weaponry, he severed communications with GDI high command. It is highly likely he will defect to the Brotherhood, and there are no diplomatic options left on the table.

You will commence a beach landing at dusk. You must eliminate the rogue commander quickly -- any protracted commitment of our forces will be difficult to explain to the public, and this situation is already enough of a debacle as-is. Good luck out there.
missions.title: Operation Guillotine

missions.briefing: Your fleet has got seperated from other Nod forces due to surprisingly aggressive GDI expansion. Break through GDI's encirclement, reunify Nod forces and demolish GDI's expansion bases. Show no mercy!
missions.title: Reunification

missions.briefing:
GDI has blocked off one of our bases. Its fall is imminent. You need to reverse the situation by any means possible!

GDI is bringing in heavy reinforcements across a bridge to the west. Destroy it as soon as possible to prevent GDI reinforcements from that direction. Stealth Tanks should prove adequate for the job.

The enemy has also blocked off our eastern reinforcement route. If you manage to clear it of GDI obstacles, we will be able to send you some reinforcements.

The bridge and the eastern road are the only aspects of the battlefield that might provide immediate relief. Use any tools in your disposal to save our base, and destroy all GDI forces in the area.

You will be kept updated in case our intelligence receives more information about GDI plans and possible vulnerabilities during the mission.

Objective: Destroy all GDI bases.
briefing_objectives: Destroy all GDI bases.
missions.title: Shadow Reprisal

missions.briefing: Sneak in to a GDI outpost and destroy their experimental weapon supplies.
missions.title: Stealthy Inhibition

missions.briefing:
A Soviet convoy with Sarin nerve gas has stopped at a nearby riverside outpost for refuelling. This is a perfect opportunity to destroy the Sarin convoy and to remove the Soviet threat in this area.

Use your forces to destroy the convoy trucks and the base. It is imperative that none of these trucks escape.

The Soviets keep their informations about their reinforcment troops in several radar domes, so destroying them could slow their retaliation strike down.
missions.title: Sarin Gas 1: Crackdown

missions.briefing:
We've traced the convoy's route to this underground facility. We suspect that this is a hidden access to the Soviet's main Sarin plant.

Lead your troops through the tunnels and remove any opposition you may find. Be careful -- the Soviets are conducting all kinds of research in this facility, and we don't know what they may throw at you.

Use spies to scout and infiltrate factories where they can steal vehicles.

The mission is complete when your forces reach the far exit of the facility.
missions.title: Sarin Gas 2: Down Under

missions.briefing:
Nod has prepared a surprise attack on a position of ours that covers an important supply route and keeps the local Tiberium growth in check. The position only has pre-GDI Allied equipment, but it'll have to do. Defend your base at all costs until reinforcements arrive!

This mission was re-balanced in mid-2021.
missions.title: Desperate Grip

missions.briefing: The Soviet Union has decided to eliminate one of our important outposts with a nuclear strike. Prevent it and destroy the missile silo.
missions.title: Frostbite

missions.briefing:
The Soviets have built a strong defense line around multiple rivers and lakes. Taking it down with a conventional attack would lead to too many casualties.

Use a Phase Transport loaded with an infantry squad to strike the Soviet power infrastructure, bringing their tesla coils offline. Once you're done, we'll send you an MCV and tanks. Break through the defense line, take control of the area and destroy all Soviet forces.
missions.title: River Raid

missions.briefing: Soviet forces have launched an all out invasion in a bid to conquer East Asia, we must prevent them at all costs!
missions.title: The East Asian Front

missions.briefing:
Our country had fallen to Soviets, but now that the Allies are getting close to Moscow, it is time to take back what rightfully belongs to us.

There are still Soviet remnants within the sector and we have located their most significant base, destroy it.
missions.title: Dawn of Liberation

missions.briefing: The Soviet remnants in our country are still occupying one of our most important cities. Thanks to your success in destroying their largest base near that village, they will no longer be able to get any *significant amount* of reinforcements. However, we can not deliver you any MCV for this operation due to lack of resources. You will instead have a taskforce of our best units at your disposal. Your mission is simple: retake the city with these units.
missions.title: Reclamation

missions.briefing: Save and take control of a Soviet base under siege and destroy the Allied presence in the area.
missions.title: Red Paradise

missions.briefing:
The Allies have fortified an ore-rich position behind a river by building a large base. Use your Soviet tank company to crush it.

The Allies are aware of us and are sending large reinforcements to the area. Expect heavy resistance and enemy reinforcements from unusual directions as you proceed through the snowy field.
missions.title: Stomp

missions.briefing: To gain control of this region, we must cross the river and establish a foothold, then take out the Allied bases. They blew up one of two bridges in the area, and have fortified the path to the second one. Fight through them and set up a base across the bridge.
missions.title: A Bridge Too Few

missions.briefing:
The Allies are building a new harbor to strengthen their already heavily fortified island chain. Allowing them to complete it would make it very hard to assault the area afterwards, so we need you to strike it at once.

Destroy the harbor and we'll send you an MCV that you can use to set up a base on the heavily fortified main island of the chain. Prepare a sufficient force for taking control of other islands in the chain, harvest all the islands for more resources and crush the Allied fortifications.
missions.title: Chainbreaker
SE Bonus Mission: Full Frontal Attack
